title: Fatty soap and generic detergent are not interchangeable in hard water
original_forecast: Only the declared fatty-soap equivalent supports the aggregate calcium-soap binding claim. A generic detergent role must not automatically be interpreted as sodium stearate.
original_limitations: The fatty soap is an explicitly unresolved equivalent, not a complete commercial formulation. Scum mass and sodium return must be reconciled from actual output.
